Department of Health and Human Services.title: HRSA FY2024 awarded grants by program
Department of Health and Human Services.basis: HRSA Data Warehouse award-year 2024 financial assistance groups 6,478 grant awards into 235 named programs. The source rows reconcile exactly to $11.2959019252B and every program is below $10B. Awards and Treasury cash outlays use different accounting measures, so this panel is a separate source-native view and is not additive to Treasury’s $14.580B HRSA net outlay.
